title: Orthogonality of indexed monomials
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite set and let $S,T\subseteq\iota$. The uniform expectation over sign assignments $x:\iota\to\{−1,1\}$ of the product of the monomials indexed by $S$ and $T$ is $1$ if $S=T$ and $0$ otherwise.
